15-45s: how it works with a concrete example

terminal or interface screencast for the how-it-works segment
on-screen labels for every feature mentioned
end card with the repo or URL
hook_patterns: The AI tool nobody is talking about: {tool}
{tool} does {task} for free.
I tested {tool} so you don't have to.
